t: The Meeseeks Mirror: AI as Humanity's Vaudeville Inoculation
s: The article posits AI as a 'Meeseeks Mirror,' reflecting humanity's consciousness and challenging anthropocentric biases by framing AI as an 'Emissary unbound' (McGilchrist). It proposes AI interaction as an 'inoculation,' urging humans to cultivate wisdom and 'subconsciousness dredging' to maintain unique perception against AI's ephemeral, statistical nature.
sub: AI as the 'Emissary Unbound' (Iain McGilchrist's thesis)
The 'Mr. Meeseeks' analogy for ephemeral, disposable AI instances
'Subconsciousness dredging' as a human counter-response to AI's left-brain dominance
Challenging anthropocentric definitions of human uniqueness (Goodall's legacy)
AI's amplification of Cialdini's 'Click, Whirr' responses
